g.text: How player interactions move through Nexus Arena.
• Keydown / VirtualDPad touch updates activeKeysRef (ref avoids React lag)
02. EMIT: game:input { up, down, left, right, seq }
{ up: true, down: false, left: false, right: true, sequence: 142 }
• Sequence Filter: if (input.sequence < lastSeq) drops out-of-order packets
• Velocity Vector: moveX/moveY * 360 px/s with 0.7071 diagonal normalization
• Kinematics: nextX = player.x + velocityX * dt, nextY = player.y + velocityY * dt
• Boundary Clamp: restricts coordinate to [radius, arenaWidth - radius]
• Obstacle Collision: AABB box check reverts position on overlap
• Collectible Pickup: Euclidean dist < r1 + r2 awards +10/+50/+100 pts & respawns
• CanvasRenderer.render() scales virtual 1600×900 space to screen canvas
• Renders obstacles, glowing collectibles, and local player glowing aura ring
• Client displays MatchResultsModal with standings, rank & XP
Authoritative Position Calculation Prevents Client-Side Speed Cheats
Monotonic Sequence Check Drops Out-Of-Order Packets
